name: Combos
description: Menus, packs and combos sold at a closed price, with ordered choice groups.

ui.emptyMenus: No menus yet. Create the first one with the + button.
ui.fieldKitchenNameHelp: Leave it empty and the kitchen ticket uses the commercial name.
ui.fieldPriceHelp: What the customer pays for the whole menu, whatever they pick.
ui.fieldTaxCategoryHelp: The rate the whole menu is billed at.
ui.supplyServiceHelp: ONE line at the menu's own rate, drinks included. This is the Spanish menu del día.
ui.supplyGoods: Sold as a product / to take away
ui.supplyGoodsHelp: The closed price is SPLIT into ONE LINE PER COMPONENT, each at its own rate.
ui.supplyGoodsWarning: This menu is billed as goods: its price will be split across the components you add, one line each.
ui.supplyServiceWarning: This menu is billed as a single service: one line at its VAT category, whatever the components are taxed at.
ui.coursesHelp: A course is a step of THIS menu — Starter, Main, Dessert, Drink. Its order is the order it is asked for.
ui.coursesEmpty: No courses yet. Add the first one — a menu with no course has nothing to pick.
ui.fieldMinHelp: 1 or more makes the course compulsory. 0 makes it optional. There is no separate switch.
ui.fieldRepeat: The same option may be picked more than once
ui.optionsEmpty: No choices yet: nobody can resolve this course.
ui.optionPickerPlaceholder: Search a product or a service…
ui.optionDeltaHelp: What substituting adds to the CLOSED price. It may be negative.
ui.editingChoice: Editing «{article}». It keeps its position in the course.
ui.catalogueMissing: {module} is not installed, so its articles cannot be picked here. Install it from the marketplace.
ui.catalogueEmpty: No articles in the catalogue yet.
ui.deleteMenuConfirm: «{name}» stops being on sale, together with its courses and choices. Tickets already issued keep reading it.
ui.deleteCourseConfirm: Remove the course «{name}» and its choices?
ui.errNoTaxCategory: A menu eaten in needs its own VAT category: without it, it cannot be billed at all.
ui.errCeilingBelowFloor: The maximum ({max}) is below the minimum ({min}): nobody could ever satisfy this course.
ui.errDuplicateArticle: This course already offers that article. To let it be picked twice, switch on «the same option may be picked more than once».
ui.errAmbiguousAmount: This amount can be read in two ways: «{typed}» could be 1250 or 1.25. Type it with its decimals — for example 1250.00 or 1.25.
ui.errNotAnAmount: This is not an amount. Type a figure, for example 12.50.
ui.errSaveMenu: The menu could not be saved.
ui.errSaveCourse: The course could not be saved.
ui.errSaveOption: The choice could not be saved.
ui.errLoadCourses: The courses of this menu could not be loaded.
ui.errDeleteMenu: The menu could not be withdrawn.
ui.errDeleteCourse: The course could not be removed.
ui.errDeleteOption: The choice could not be removed.

errors.combos.combo_in_use: This menu is being used and cannot be withdrawn: {message}
